strapiBlog.title: UAE National Day Renamed as Eid Al Etihad: Celebrations Planned for 2024
strapiBlog.short_description: The UAE is set to celebrate its 53rd National Day with a new name, Eid Al Etihad, symbolizing the unity and progress of the nation. The renaming reflects the enduring spirit of solidarity that has defined the UAE since its founding on December 2, 1971.

data.text:
The UAE is set to celebrate its 53rd National Day with a new name, Eid Al Etihad, symbolizing the unity and progress of the nation. The renaming reflects the enduring spirit of solidarity that has defined the UAE since its founding on December 2, 1971. This annual celebration marks the unification of the seven emirates under the leadership of the late His Highness Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, ushering in a new era of development and prosperity.

Significance of Eid Al Etihad

Eid Al Etihad, meaning "Festival of the Union," celebrates the nation’s remarkable journey from its inception to becoming a global leader in economic, cultural, and social development. The day is a tribute to the vision of the UAE’s founders and the unity of its people.

Eisa Alsubousi, director of Strategic and Creative Affairs of the Organising Committee of the 53rd UAE National Day Celebration, remarked: 

“We are delighted to invite everyone to share in the joy of this historic moment, as we celebrate the unification of the seven emirates. To support these festivities, we have created comprehensive guides to inspire and assist in preparations to celebrate sustainably. We encourage government entities, private companies, schools, and families to download these resources and join in marking this significant celebration.”

Grand Celebrations Planned Across the UAE

This year’s Eid Al Etihad promises an exciting lineup of events, from spectacular fireworks displays to cultural performances and family-friendly activities. Across the Emirates, residents and visitors can enjoy concerts, parades, and mesmerizing light shows that highlight the nation’s achievements.

UAE National Day Holidays 2024

UAE National Day is Monday, December 2, 2024. Before the grand celebrations of Eid Al Etihad, the UAE will also observe Commemoration Day on Sunday, December 1. This significant day, previously known as Martyrs' Day, honors the sacrifices made by the nation's heroes. 

Residents can enjoy a four-day break from Friday, November 29, to Tuesday, December 3, 2024. This extended break offers families a perfect opportunity to come together and enjoy the vibrant festivities., covering both Commemoration Day and UAE National Day Holiday 2024. The final public holiday for the year will be New Year’s Day on January 1, 2025, providing one more occasion to gather and celebrate.

data.answer: UAE National Day is celebrated every year on December 2nd.

faqs.question: How many years is UAE National Day?

data.answer: The UAE will have its 53rd National Day in 2024. This marks 53 years since the union of the seven emirates in 1971.
UAE National Day commemorates the founding of the United Arab Emirates on December 2, 1971, when the seven emirates came together to form a unified nation.

faqs.question: Why is UAE National Day celebrated?

data.answer: UAE National Day is celebrated to honor the unity and formation of the UAE, recognizing the efforts of the founding fathers, particularly late H.H Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, who played a pivotal role in establishing the federation.

faqs.question: How many days of holiday for UAE National Day?

data.answer: Typically, the UAE government announces a two-day holiday for National Day, often combined with Commemoration Day, resulting in an extended weekend for both public and private sector employees.
